notes.title: Updated Demo + Kickstarter
notes.content:
Lock & Key: A Magical Girl Mystery's updated demo is now available to everyone! We've completely overhauled the look of Lock & Key, featuring brand new character artwork by milkgrrl, an updated UI, and more. It was previously released for Patrons on our [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/vnstudioelan/membership]Demo Access tier[/url], which gives Patrons early access to demo & beta builds for some of our games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/690c03a835684a499d7ec7e1a0103e5eb1e2f91b.jpg[/img]

This new demo comes out to mark the beginning of [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vnstudioelan/lock-and-key-a-magical-girl-mystery-visual-novel]our Kickstarter campaign[/url]! We have physical game copies, an artbook, keychains, and more up for preorder as part of the campaign.

[previewyoutube=rwmYHRWiubU;full][/previewyoutube]

We also have a few stretch goals to improve the game we'd like to hit - and with your support, we can!

Thank you everyone for your support. If you want more frequent updates on Lock & Key, we're doing monthly update posts on [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/vnstudioelan/]our Patreon[/url].

notes.title: New Artwork!
notes.content:
Lock & Key is getting an art upgrade! The main artist, milkgrrl, is redoing some of the artwork to make it more stylized and expressive. Most of these artwork upgrades are finished and we've shown off some of them before on [url=https://www.patreon.com/vnstudioelan]our Patreon[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/dNZYDaGbh9]Discord server[/url], so today we're compiling a lot of the new artwork into one post.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/0f231d4c3db391dc17889c2ce2c76b966e3ef0f3.png[/img]
For reference, this is what the old character sprite art looks like in the current demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/1e6f5e80676ac876a642670bf54776e1a7d7fb59.png[/img]
We also have some casual outfits for the girls!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/344bb1ff69646131179f9f9fa2c556426b489811.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/e213b2306c7a284e408fc4dc451b9f5394de6e65.png[/img]
 And we also have some new screenshots with these sprites and an updated GUI!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/20d4788377e9aa12adbe8888f78c41224c63da4f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/a2f45637e8b2ca2733693bbf280bf9e22b5b651b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390323/87f25d8d6ece8c4947131e56e9246ff39b879365.png[/img]
This updated artwork will be available in a new demo coming out in around a month. It'll be the same as the current demo on here on Steam, just with updated visuals, so if you want to see more about the story & characters then go ahead and give it a try!

If you want to see more posts about Lock & Key, we have an entire collection of them [url=https://www.patreon.com/collection/513950?view=expanded]on Patreon[/url], including updates and process posts.

We're still planning on a Kickstarter for Lock & Key Kickstarter for the end of the year, which will allow us to offset some of the costs from production as well as give you the chance to get merch such as physical PC copies, keychains, etc. and some exclusives!
